messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> inference-gateway-prod (usw2) :rotating_light:
alert: http_5xx_rate > 4.8% over 2m | severity: P1 | rule: gateway.5xx_rate

oncall_ryan: Acked. I'm on it, checking dashboards and logs.

pagerbot: Auto-escalation scheduled in 4m -> team-lead if no ack escalation.

maya: Seeing a sharp spike in 502s originating from auth-proxy (token-introspect). 99th latency to auth ~600ms, many `upstream reset` in logs.

jun: Quick counts: `http_logs` query for last 2m in usw2 -> 1,250 errors (baseline ~15). This is not noise.

sre-lead-ana: @oncall_ryan good catch. Follow runbook /runbooks/gateway-502-throttle: 1) scale gateway 2) route partial traffic to fallback region 3) assess upstream auth. Can you start 1+2?

oncall_ryan: Doing now — scaling inference-gateway pool +20% and shifting 30% of non-enterprise traffic to usw1. Commands run:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-gateway --record
```

support-alex: Noted customer impact: 2 enterprise customers opened tickets (S2). Support notified them we're investigating and routing to workaround.

maya: After scale + partial routing -> 502 rate dropped 5.1% -> 2.2% in the last minute, still elevated but trending down. Auth-proxy still showing upstream resets.

jun: Patching suggestion: bump auth-proxy replicas + increase upstream connection timeout to reduce resets. I'll prepare a cfg change in staging for quick promotion.

sre-lead-ana: If auth patch doesn't stabilize, be ready to rollback the auth service canary deployed ~1857600000. Prep rollback steps and list affected hashes.

oncall_ryan: Leaving breakglass notes in incident doc, handing off live monitoring to @maya for next 25m while I take the rotation break. Handoff: current mitigations in place, watch 5xx and auth latency.

pagerbot: Page acknowledged. Auto-escalation cancelled.

incident-bot: Appended incident markers to #incidents-log and created incident-ticket INC-1857654321. Tagging for follow-up if 5xx_rate > 1% for next 2h.

maya: :thumbsup: Monitoring dashboards and support thread. Will escalate if errors rebound.
